issue.title: Orphaned untracked prompt-archive objects in the agents sidecar clone persist for weeks and block sase final prepare
issue.description:
Reported by phase bead sase-17o.2 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #3) as blocking `sase final prepare` for every agent; independently reproduced by the sase-17o land agent on 2026-09-24:

    $ sase repo open agents -r "..."   # -> ~/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/repos/agents
    $ git status --short -uall
    ?? files/objects/sha256/40/40de62d889bdb2a7cbf17a5fcaf86d0913c5f07b794eb7561a98d2df10bda5bb   (mtime 2026-08-29)
    ?? files/objects/sha256/41/414a92e8e104e8131ae51a48d7cece6e8f1410f6f76bf97ee7d3a2a5b79e02c8   (mtime 2026-09-15)
    ?? files/objects/sha256/5b/5bd2b6fd34a08c1ef53cdadbc2a759340118ec0fd0d9e260f248f73309a28cf3   (mtime 2026-09-06)

These untracked prompt-archive objects in the primary agents sidecar clone have survived for weeks. The phase agent reported that the finalizer classifies them as protected + foreign and refuses to proceed. Nothing publishes or sweeps orphaned archive objects. Needs root cause (which archive write left them unpublished; compare closed sase-fi "Prompt-archive publication has no durable retry path") plus a durable fix: publish or quarantine orphaned objects instead of letting them wedge finalization.

payload.description: Closed prompt-archive publication retry task; these orphaned objects suggest publication still leaves objects behind

evidence.note: Reported by phase bead sase-17x.10 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #2: 'sase final prepare blocked by pre-existing untracked agents-sidecar files/objects (Aug-Sep, predates turn); prepared completion rejects deferrals'). Re-verified by the sase-17x land agent on 2026-09-24 at sase master 55936f429: git status -uall in the primary agents sidecar clone still shows exactly the same 3 untracked files/objects/sha256/{40/40de62..,41/414a92..,5b/5bd2b6..} objects, so the wedge persists and still hits epic phase workers.

Independently reproduced 2026-09-25 while investigating the sase-17m.5.1.6.3 agent (muse, workspace sase_14). Its 'sase final prepare' was refused three times (10:50:50Z, 10:51:58Z, 10:52:08Z) with 'protected path files/objects/sha256/40/40de62d8...bda5bb in repo-f52723edcc8b makes the intent ineligible'. repo-f52723edcc8b is sha256({kind:sdd,name:'agents prompt archive',path:~/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/repos/agents})[:12], which confirms the blocker is this sidecar clone. The same three untracked objects are still present (git status -uall). Downstream impact is worse than 'blocks prepare': the agent fell back to a hand-built 'sase final submit' manifest, and ea130c678 landed on master as 'feat(scope): describe the completed work', the finalizer template's placeholder message. The object hash appears in 29 muse sessions (09-23: 5, 09-24: 22, 09-25: 2) plus 7 Claude sessions, so most agents in that window hit this blocker.

payload.description: The sase-17u sidecar dirt blocks 'sase final prepare', which pushes agents onto the raw 'sase final submit' fallback where the placeholder message slipped through

evidence.note: Proposed by phase sase-17x.13.7 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #2, 2026-09-25 01:33 EDT), routed by the sase-17x.13 land agent: sase final prepare was ineligible for that phase because untracked protected path files/objects/sha256/40/40de62d889bdb2a7cbf17a5fcaf86d0913c5f07b794eb7561a98d2df10bda5bb (mtime 2026-08-29, foreign) still sits in the shared agents sidecar clone, so prepared monitor completion could not land. Same object as this bead's first listing; still unswept a day after filing.

Independently reproduced 2026-09-25 at sase master f648e88e4 (already contains sase-196.1's prompt-archive commit fix, so that fix does not clear the existing orphans): 'sase final prepare' for a prepared-completion verify monitor is refused with 'protected path files/objects/sha256/40/40de62d8... in repo-f52723edcc8b makes the intent ineligible' (the agents sidecar clone, not the agent's own workspace). Impact: a normal agent cannot use prepared host completion for final verification and has to fall back to a monitor plus a follow-up turn that submits the declaration by hand.

Independently reproduced 2026-09-25 during sase-18z.3.1 verification at sase master 4214ccc65: just check / sase validate fails agent prompts validate with the same 3 untracked sidecar objects (40de62d8, 414a92e8, 5bd2b6fd) plus a new artifact-missing on prompts/202609/bbugyi200.apollo.2.md targeting files/objects/sha256/41/412ed4ed462f3f76938f9846b24973ee9d2783d09fa7a3e747e24dd2581b6268. Failure is identical on the clean base tree with this phase stashed, so it is not caused by width-aware note wrapping.

payload.description: Need the existing tracker for prompt-archive orphan objects that caused the clean-base validation failure
Need the candidate report for prompt-archive untracked objects

payload.entry: Corroborated 2026-09-25 by fork-wait recovery turn (0s3--1): the same 3 orphaned objects now fail 'just check' as artifact-untracked errors under the new prompt-archive object validation (sase@4214ccc65 'feat(agents): validate archive objects'). Same run also shows artifact-missing: prompts/202609/bbugyi200.apollo.2.md references files/objects/sha256/41/412ed4ed462f3f76938f9846b24973ee9d2783d09fa7a3e747e24dd2581b6268 which exists neither on disk nor in origin/main (remote has zero files/ objects), so the gate is red independent of any working-tree fix. Fork-wait implementation itself verified separately (new + 185 related tests pass; ruff/mypy/fmt clean).
